captions.linkedin:
One prompt. Three stages.

You can stack prompt patterns in a single prompt. The AI then works in layers. First it gathers information. Then it breaks down the problem. Then it writes the answer. Each pattern is one stage of thinking.

FIP: the AI interviews you first. CVP: it splits the task into sub-questions. RT: it reads the problem from several angles.

The order matters. Patterns that run before the answer win. They beat patterns that run after it. Collect what is missing upfront. Don't catch mistakes afterward.

This is the move from prompting to control. You define how the AI thinks first. Then it produces.

Try FIP + CVP on your next complex request.

https://metaxis.io/blog/combining-prompt-patterns-thinking-modes
